A future worth looking up to

Every day building GigLoft and other projects, I learn new ways to build our futures as creatives, and why it matters so much that we succeed at the opportunity to create every single day, the way Inktober challenges us to. Our gifts must never be squandered.

About this piece

Every day building GigLoft and other projects, I learn new ways to build our futures as creatives, and why it matters so much that we succeed at the opportunity to create every single day, the way Inktober challenges us to. Our gifts must never be squandered.
